::: {.faq-item}
### Where does the WNBA data come from?

Compiled by Slam Dunk Bets from the WNBA's official game statistics: player box scores and starting lineups. Fantasy points, usage rate and rest days are computed from those box scores by the formulas in the column descriptions.
:::

::: {.faq-item}
### When are in-season WNBA files updated?

Rebuilt every morning by 8 AM ET in season (May to October). Completed seasons are final and only change if we repost a correction.
:::
